use net:System.Math as NetMath
use net:System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex as Rx
use js:"node:path/posix" as path
use go:strings as gstr

unit m
unit km = 1000 m
unit g
unit kg = 1000 g
currency EUR, SEK

record LegIn {
    route: Text
    dx_km: Float
    dy_km: Float
    weight_g: Float
    zone: Text
}

record QuoteReq {
    eur_to_sek: Float
    max_sek: Int
    legs: List[LegIn]
}

record EvaluatedLeg {
    depot: Text
    zone: Text
    valid: Bool
    heavy: Bool
    long_haul: Bool
    vip_exempt: Bool
    dist_km: Float[km]
    weight_kg: Float[kg]
    fee_eur: Float[EUR]
    fee_eur_cents: Int
}

fn extract_depot(route: Text) -> Text =
    path.basename(path.normalize(route))

fn normalize_zone(zone: Text) -> Text =
    gstr.ToUpper(gstr.TrimSpace(zone))

fn is_valid_zone(zone: Text) -> Bool pure =
    zone == "SE" or zone == "EU" or zone == "NON-EU"

fn leg_distance(dx_km: Float, dy_km: Float) -> Float[km] =
    NetMath.Sqrt(dx_km * dx_km + dy_km * dy_km) as km

fn leg_weight(weight_g: Float) -> Float[kg] pure =
    (weight_g as g) to kg

fn distance_multiplier(km_val: Float) -> Float pure = cases km_val {
    <= 50.0 => 1.0
    <= 200.0 => 1.15
    else => 1.35
}

fn is_heavy(weight: Float[kg]) -> Bool pure =
    scalar(weight) >= 10.0

fn is_vip_depot(depot: Text, zone: Text) -> Bool pure =
    depot == "sto-01" and zone == "SE"

fn leg_fee(dist: Float[km], weight: Float[kg], exempt_heavy: Bool) -> Float[EUR] pure =
    let base = (5.0 + 0.5 * scalar(dist) + 2.0 * scalar(weight)) as EUR in
    let tiered = base * distance_multiplier(scalar(dist)) in
    if exempt_heavy then tiered
    else if is_heavy(weight) then tiered + (12.0 as EUR)
    else tiered

fn apply_zone_adjustment(fee: Float[EUR], zone: Text) -> Float[EUR] pure =
    if zone == "SE" then fee * 0.9
    else if zone == "NON-EU" then fee + (15.0 as EUR)
    else fee

fn eval_leg(leg: LegIn) -> EvaluatedLeg =
    let depot = extract_depot(leg.route) in
    let zone = normalize_zone(leg.zone) in
    let valid = Rx.IsMatch(depot, "^[a-z]{3}-[0-9]{2}$") and is_valid_zone(zone) in
    let dist_km = leg_distance(leg.dx_km, leg.dy_km) in
    let weight_kg = leg_weight(leg.weight_g) in
    let heavy = is_heavy(weight_kg) in
    let long_haul = scalar(dist_km) > 100.0 in
    let vip_depot = is_vip_depot(depot, zone) in
    let vip_exempt = vip_depot and heavy in
    let fee_eur = apply_zone_adjustment(leg_fee(dist_km, weight_kg, vip_depot), zone) in
    let fee_eur_cents = round_even(scalar(fee_eur) * 100.0) in
    EvaluatedLeg(depot: depot, zone: zone, valid: valid, heavy: heavy, long_haul: long_haul, vip_exempt: vip_exempt, dist_km: dist_km, weight_kg: weight_kg, fee_eur: fee_eur, fee_eur_cents: fee_eur_cents)

let req: QuoteReq = from_json(stdin_text())
let evaluated = [eval_leg(leg) for leg in req.legs]

let summary = summarize x in evaluated {
    legs: count
    valid_legs: count where x.valid
    heavy_legs: count where x.valid and x.heavy
    customs_legs: count where x.valid and x.zone == "NON-EU"
    vip_exempt: count where x.valid and x.vip_exempt
    total_km: sum x.dist_km where x.valid
    total_eur: sum x.fee_eur where x.valid
    max_leg_eur_cents: max x.fee_eur_cents where x.valid default 0
}

let valid_evaluated = [x for x in evaluated where x.valid]
let long_haul_pairs = count adjacent past, now in valid_evaluated where past.long_haul and now.long_haul
let rest_fee: Float[EUR] = (25.0 * to_float(long_haul_pairs)) as EUR
let total_eur: Float[EUR] = summary.total_eur + rest_fee

let total_m = round_even(scalar(summary.total_km to m))
let total_eur_cents = round_even(scalar(total_eur) * 100.0)
let total_sek_val: Float[SEK] = (scalar(total_eur) * req.eur_to_sek) as SEK
let total_sek = round_even(scalar(total_sek_val))
let within_cap = total_sek <= req.max_sek

let out = record {
    legs: summary.legs,
    valid_legs: summary.valid_legs,
    total_m,
    total_eur_cents,
    total_sek,
    heavy_legs: summary.heavy_legs,
    customs_legs: summary.customs_legs,
    long_haul_pairs,
    vip_exempt: summary.vip_exempt,
    within_cap,
    max_leg_eur_cents: summary.max_leg_eur_cents
}

print json_encode(out)
